post_actual_changes: Only three fault-injection tests and their cfg(test) module declaration were added after the actual SDK run; production coordinator code is unchanged. The actual image and later default-test image have distinct recorded hashes.
limitations: No public prepare/commit switch route is exposed yet; 42 production unused-entry warnings remain visible on Rust1.88.
Known failure after source revocation can require recovery; automatic known-failure restoration and explicit latest-data rollback remain unfinished.
Cleanup-pending recovery, durable interrupted erasure, per-scope deletion across all retained/prepared copies and comprehensive crash/Stop races remain unfinished.
Memory-only reviewed notes refuse unsupported transfer rather than being silently dropped.

Actual proof uses finalSDK0.14.1 with v1 enrollment, a test-only qualified target and external CPython3.14.7/3.14.10; not original b47380, a newer SDK, managed-interpreter end-to-end or all-platform qualification.
P7/P8 controls/catalog policy and P9/P10 installed/frozen/platform/parent-loss/approval/transport/load/performance qualification remain required.
